text_block_list.name: A Certain Umamusume's Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—It all started with footraces against my 
sister.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Umamusume's Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just an innocent footrace between sisters. 
...It really was that simple and innocent.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Umamusume's Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yet I desperately chased after my sister's 
back. Like a beast reveling in 
exhilaration.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Umamusume's Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Pump your legs, draw air into your lungs. 
And pump your legs once more――"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Umamusume's Monologue
text_block_list.text: —This truly is my breathing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
—A short while later, the back she was 
meant to chase had vanished.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I was all alone.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yet even when I was left alone, I 
remembered how to breathe.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
And then I understood. That breathing can 
also give rise to thirst.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"The harder I breathe with all my might, 
the thirstier and more unquenchable my 
throat becomes."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: However, I cannot stop breathing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Even if it turns out to be an act 
accompanied by pain. Because this is for 
the sake of survival.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: But what if... what if this body...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
If the day ever comes that rejects my very 
breath.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I suppose that's when it'll be.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch... As if I'd... ever lose!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: She's... still running?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Mayano won't be the only one at 
Arima. I'm definitely chasing after you 
too...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, Hishi Ama aside, Mayano, your 
next race is the Takarazuka Kinen, right? 
Shouldn't you get some proper rest?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wait, Mayano? Yoo-hoo?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...I figured it out.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ? ...Mayano?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
No, this can't be real... How could this 
happen...?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Because there's no way that's...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Mayano!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Trainer-chan.
choice_data_list: So what did you figure out?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Maya noticed something.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
No matter how brilliantly it shone, that 
sun was already setting.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If we don't hurry, it'll sink. To a place 
where nobody can reach it.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Even though I haven't even caught up side 
by side yet—...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
............ ...So you noticed too, 
Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I tried thinking back on everything up 
until now.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—Even that person wanted to feel that 
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"I just wanted to run with all my might, 
and say, 'That was fun.'"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That's why I kept struggling all this 
time. Believing that the day would surely 
come when I could say those words.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—Even if I have to drag this body that 
won't respond to my desire to sparkle 
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-chan! I don't wanna back down 
like this.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If the Arima Kinen really is going to be 
her very last race...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
On that day, as "Mayano Top Gun", I wanna 
beat that person and puff my chest out 
with pride!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"‘Maya's full power was stronger than your 
full power, wasn't it?’ she said."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "‘Maya made your heart race, didn't she!’"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll definitely see it through to 
the end!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Grow stronger at the Takarazuka Kinen, 
and get faster at the Tenno Sho (Autumn)."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: At the Arima Kinen, I'll beat her—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: —If the time ever comes to surpass them.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Look only at Maya, and praise me, saying, 
'You sparkled brighter than anyone else.'
